title: Closure under one transition
statement: Let $r,K,u,v$ be natural numbers. If $u$ is reachable from some vertex below $K$ accepted by the initial-vertex oracle query, using a finite sequence of oracle-accepted transitions whose endpoints are below $K$, and the step oracle accepts a transition from $u$ to $v$ with $v<K$, then $v$ is reachable in the same sense.
hypotheses_covered: The step oracle accepts the transition from $u$ to $v$
